title: Morning Water
tips: Drink 1–2 glasses of water after waking up
Aim for 2–3 litres through the day
Don't wait until you feel thirsty

title: Walk Every Day
tips: Walk briskly for 30 minutes a day
A 10-minute walk after meals helps digestion
Take the stairs instead of the lift

title: Sleep Well
tips: Adults need 7–8 hours of sleep
Go to bed at the same time daily
Keep your phone away an hour before bed

title: Cut Down Sugar
tips: Swap soft drinks for buttermilk or water
Slowly reduce sugar in tea and coffee
Craving sweets? Eat a fruit instead

title: Eat the Rainbow
tips: Eat at least 2 kinds of fruit daily
Fill half your plate with vegetables
More colours means more nutrients

title: Morning Sunlight
tips: Get 15–20 minutes of morning sun
A natural way to get vitamin D
Good for strong bones and mood

title: Breathe Deeply
tips: Breathe in for 4 seconds
Hold for 4, breathe out for 6
5 minutes a day lowers stress

title: Rest Your Eyes
tips: Follow the 20-20-20 rule
Every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away
Keep looking for 20 seconds

title: Less Salt
tips: Adults need under 5 g of salt a day
Pickles and chips are very salty
Don't add extra salt at the table

title: Never Skip Breakfast
tips: Breakfast fuels your morning
Idli, pesarattu or upma are great picks
Add eggs or dal for protein

title: Eat Slowly
tips: Chew every bite well
Take 15–20 minutes for a meal
No phone or TV while eating

title: Sit Less, Move More
tips: Stand up and move every hour
Sit with your back straight
Keep your screen at eye level

title: Wash Your Hands
tips: Wash with soap before every meal
Scrub for at least 20 seconds
Wash as soon as you get home

title: Buttermilk Benefits
tips: A great summer drink
Helps digestion
Add cumin and curry leaves for flavour

title: Early Dinner
tips: Eat 2–3 hours before bed
Keep dinner light
Don't lie down right after eating

title: Stretch in the Morning
tips: Stretch for 5 minutes after waking
Your body feels more active
Reduces muscle stiffness

title: Power of Sprouts
tips: Soak and sprout moong or chana
Rich in protein and fibre
One cup makes a great breakfast

title: Phone Habits
tips: Don't check your phone right after waking
Spend one hour a day phone-free
Keep only important notifications on

title: Laugh More
tips: A good laugh lowers stress
Spend time with friends and family
Laughter is free medicine

title: Less Oil
tips: Fried food only once a week
Don't reheat the same oil again and again
Prefer steamed and boiled dishes

title: Are You Hydrated?
tips: Pale yellow urine means well hydrated
Dark colour means drink more water
Drink extra on hot days

title: Practice Gratitude
tips: Note 3 things you're grateful for daily
Write them down before bed
It calms the mind

title: Care for Your Teeth
tips: Brush twice a day
Never skip brushing at night
See a dentist every 6 months

title: Skip the Junk Food
tips: Eat out only once a week
Home-cooked food is healthiest
Read labels before buying packaged food

title: Daily Yoga
tips: Do 15 minutes of yoga daily
Start with surya namaskar
Strengthens body and mind

title: Smart Snacking
tips: Hungry? Choose peanuts over biscuits
A handful of almonds or a fruit
Beats the afternoon slump

title: Yearly Check-up
tips: After 30, get a yearly health check-up
Check blood pressure and sugar
Early detection makes prevention easy

title: Manage Stress
tips: Do one thing at a time
Keep 10 minutes a day just for you
Listen to music or take a walk

title: Kitchen Spices
tips: Turmeric, ginger and cumin are treasures
Use them in everyday cooking
But they don't replace medicines

title: Small Changes Win
tips: Don't try to change everything at once
Start with one good habit
Small changes bring big results
